manual_review_notes: Exploratory pose-repair variant of the existing VCN35_005 family. Parent historical native result was 2/5; this fresh run uses the established RAIN checkpoints and seeds 7–11, and is not a matched-seed comparison or evidence of improved success rate. Ramekin grasp/basket placement and tomato/right-plate placement include the object-binding transfers documented below. The selected 60 tasks are unchanged.

episode_reviews.notes: Reviewed all 48 decoded video frames and independently reconstructed ordered native milestones [101, 368]. Deliberate ramekin grasp and basket placement, then tomato grasp, transport, and release onto plate_2. Ramekin remains stationary throughout the second action (maximum displacement 3.8e-14 m after control 112), with no loss of its basket predicate. Final gripper aperture is about 7.03 cm and there are no gripper contacts during the last two controls. No earlier placement damage or accidental goal observed.

Reviewed all 55 decoded video frames and independently reconstructed ordered native milestones [99, 425]. Deliberate ramekin grasp and basket placement, then tomato grasp, transport, and release onto plate_2. The ramekin settles tilted against the basket interior during its initial release (not an upright-placement task); it never leaves the basket and is stationary from control 130 onward (maximum subsequent displacement 1.7e-11 m), throughout the tomato pickup/placement. A brief release/withdrawal finger contact ends at control 114, with no later gripper contact or displacement. Tomato is released upright, final gripper opening about 6.47 cm; last tomato contact control 423 and no contacts in final two controls. No downstream damage or accidental goal observed.
